reviews.title: Worst experience ever
reviews.text: They violated the international transportation rules for hand luggage cited on their website forcing me to register my medicine as a separate baggage as well as extremely rude service on the airplane that is not acceptable. Customer service cites 30 business days for a standard reply that still hasn't responded to me. Save the headache and fly a different airline.
reviews.author: Aida

reviews.title: Pleasant surprise
reviews.text: I bought the ticket because the route was cheaper than with Azal. I was concerned about transferring in Baku because online I needed to change terminals. But I didn't need to leave the terminal-the directions in the terminal were in English so I could follow them easily. I arrived and departed on Buta airlines. There are chairs with no arms near the "cocoon area" where you can lie down during long layovers. Buta offers a sandwich and hot beverage even on a 50 minute flight. I ordered a special meal online for two flights of my 4 flights, but they only had the meal on one of them. The embarrassed stewardess brought me other food to try and find something for me to eat. She said she would write a note that they didn't have the food that I had bought. I've sent a request to get my money returned; we'll see.
reviews.author: Mara G

reviews.title: Good flight
reviews.text: The flying time between airports was not long +-1hr 10 mins. The seats were comfortable and there was adequate legroom.
reviews.author: Adventurers049

reviews.title: Buta Airways flight J29224 from Tbilisi to Baku was a have safe and reliable flight
reviews.text: We have bought tickets with Azerbaijan Airlines, but we were flown with Buta Airways (a 100% subsidiary of Azerbaijan Airlines), taken the flight J29224 from Tbilisi [Shota Rustaveli International Airport (TBS) to Baku [Heydar Aliyev International Airport (GYD) ] on board of an Embraer-190 (a small aircraft with a seat configuration of 2+2), which was a smooth short flight (about one hour) without any turbulences and problems. No one has explained to us that we will fly with BUTA AIRWAYA although the tickets are with Azerbaijan Airlines. Both take-off and landing was very good and the Baku airport was impressive. The service on board was good and they offered tea, coffee, juice, without charge [and wine on payment] although it was a very short flight. I liked my flight from Tbilisi to Baku and probably I will fly again if I am in the area of Caucasus.
reviews.author: Κωνσταντίνος Δ

reviews.title: Customer service
reviews.text: We bought our tickets to Baku in January 2020. Since the pandemic started, all flights were canceled. After 2 years!! we still didn't receive our money back. All this time we have been trying to contact customer service, but always got the same answer, which they just copied and pasted from their website. If it would only be 2 tickets that's ok, we would wait until they resume their flights. But I'm talking about 10! 10 tickets!! I Would Not recommend Buta air to anyone. It is better to overpay with Turkish airlines, at least you will know that if something happens they will always return your money. Very disappointed.
reviews.author: Anna E

reviews.title: STILL WAITING FOR REFUND OVER 2 YEARS AFTER PAYING FOR CANCELLED FIGHT
reviews.text: Booked a flight in November 2019 which was cancelled in June 2020 due to Covid. Still waiting for a refund. They give the same excuse to every email about returning your money 60 days after normal return to operations. They are already operating normally. DO NOT BOOK with them. They will try to keep your money.
reviews.author: Pat

reviews.title: Shouldn't be operating, disgusting
reviews.text: Flights cancelled due to pandemic over a year ago from New York - Dubai. Fought for a refund for over a year. They finally gave me a voucher after kicking and screaming. I re-booked flights with voucher and then they cancelled second leg and then first leg shortly after of flight after I had already booked my accommodation and tours for the trip. Customer service in Dubai is great, Customer service in Azerbaijan are terrible. I was even laughed at over one call. Shouldn't even be allowed to operate, by far the worst experience I've ever had in my life and agree with other reviews, they don't care at all.
reviews.author: becbresich

reviews.title: Ticket cancellation
reviews.text: Buta and Azal definitely rippers, I m an azeri but I feel shameful of their service too, my foreigner friends complained to me about it. We wanted to cancel our tickets and we sent them 3 days ago but they did not process it and we lost 75% of the ticket vaule, if they processed a day before it was 50%. Anyway terrible service and absolute rippers. I dont recommend Turkish airlines having joint flights with them too!
reviews.author: Ayshen

reviews.title: Very RUDE workers!
reviews.text: Every time bad experience. The staff is so rude!!! No respect to passengers. They have no idea what is GOOD SERVICE! Try to skip this airport, very unprofessional specially women workers! They should learn from Turkey hospitality! Me and my family members having difficult time every time at GYD! Place should monitor workers to see how bad they work!
reviews.author: Anna G

reviews.title: Decent Flight
reviews.text: The flight seating was comfortable. The whole experience was pretty decent. Even though was a full flight I was satisfied with the flight. Would try it again someday. It is much better than most of the low cost airlines I would have flown.
reviews.author: Jetskii

reviews.title: Normal Flight
reviews.text: The flight was on time and soft, every thing went well and was nothing to complain, i think this airline is a good choice for a trip in this route
reviews.author: shiraziwine

reviews.title: The airilne are so stingy -They  have postponed paying my ticket for a month
reviews.text: The airline was so stingy and there are two points that I want to share: 1-Due to coronavirus the airline canceled my return flight but they have told the agency that they would return my money another month. 2- Selling soda cans in my opinion disrespectful to the customer, especially in order to pay the money the customer has to touch the money with is not the right thing to do.
reviews.author: friod

reviews.author: Ibrahim A

reviews.title: Worst airline ever
reviews.text: They always show fake prices on the site, in the end you pay triple or more. The difference between baggage and without baggage (not even hand luggage) is $100+. There are dozens of manipulations on the site. You cannot check 2 people nearby, even if there is free space, so you have to pay for it. You cannot see the entire luggage option on the first page, you need to make a maneuver to understand that you have another option on the inner pages, a little cheaper than on the main page. Previously, you had a chance to departure from Zhulhany, since the Zhulhany are located near the city center, but now Buta departure only from Boryspil, which is located outside of Kiev. Cheap Airlines with Fancy prices.
reviews.author: Konul

reviews.title: Worst airline
reviews.text: You know how there are some strategies low cost airlines use to save money and be able to sell the tickets for cheaper? Buta airways applied all those strategies. I have flown budget airlines dozens of time but I never had to pay for a carry on baggage, or for a backpack and with buta it is 25 euros, and for check in 15 euros. Really stupid. They are just showing wrong prices on the website you end up paying twice the amount.

reviews.title: Good Value comfortable flight
reviews.text: Flew from TBS to GYD and then GYD to IEV . Good legroom on their Embraer 190 much better than a lot of low cost airlines . Baggage drop at TBS and GYD were both quick and painless . Boarding efficient , free sandwich and water . Facilities at GYD old terminal pretty basic. As long as you follow their baggage policy and pre pay for baggage it should still be good value and you shouldn't have any issues at check in.
reviews.author: Phil

reviews.title: The only company in the world that makes you pay for carry on luggage
reviews.text: Buta airways makes you pay 25 euros for carry on luggage if you have 'budget' class tickets. After decades of travels this never happened to me.
reviews.author: CyclOrBit

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: AWFUL It is cheap because it is the worst. Good planes but angry staff. Don't eat their foods. Their terminal in Baku is so poor. Arrival in Baku is beautiful but leaving Baku is TERRIBLE. Tehran's biggest bus terminal (Jonoub) is more professional and beautiful than theirs.
reviews.author: rezahan

reviews.title: Hospitable and friendly cabin crew
reviews.text: GYD-TBS. Boarding of the plane was quite early with passengers on board promptly which meant an on-time pushback from Heydar Aliyev Terminal 2. During the flight there were two service runs, one was offering complimentary sandwiches consisting of 2 choices and also glasses of water; the other offered food & beverages for purchase at reasonable prices. The cabin crew were friendly and attentive throughout the journey and it seems to set Buta Airways apart from other airlines because of the excellent hospitality received on board. Arrival into Tbilisi International Airport was 10 minutes ahead of schedule. Hope to use Buta Airways again in the future.
reviews.author: Paul Legate

reviews.title: A much better experience than expected
reviews.text: TBS-GYD. I really wasn't too sure what to expect of Buta Airways but they were absolutely fine for the short journey to Baku. Check-in was painless with a charge being made for hand luggage on a budget ticket at 88 lari for an item up to 10kg, this was an expected add-on fee. Boarding was hassle-free with a good welcome from the crew on board. The plane was an Embraer E-190 with comfortable seats and a good amount of legroom. During the flight a glass of water and baguette was handed out which was very tasty and ample for a short flight. It was a 50 minute flight and arrival into Baku was about 10 minutes ahead of schedule. It was a very good introduction to Buta Airways.
reviews.author: Paul Legate

reviews.title: Fine
reviews.text: Everything went smoothly here. Boarding was quicwk and on time. We were pushed back on time, which also meant the flight left on time. It was only a short hop of 55mins. I will see how they hard again when I fly 3hours plus on my next flight. Overall No issues. Airline very smooth would recommend.
reviews.author: Richard L

reviews.title: Racist encounter with passengers
reviews.text: I traveled from tehran to baku with one 10 kg baggage and one backpack without any problem but on return time your employe on counter 58 (terminal 2 heydar aliyev airport) stopped me for my backpack and unfortunately started very bad situation for me . They action were so bad and racist . they permit backpack and many bags for azerbaijan pepole or who was talking Turkish or Azerbaijan language but at least 2 hours annoyed me. unfortunately employers behavior were so inhumane and instead of solving problem and helping me ,hurt me, and making alibi and insult to my country .andone person of them told me « you are lying » . my travel was not only tourist but also for medical help to azerbaijan peoples but this terrible event make me hesitant .
reviews.author: Dlsh

reviews.title: it was fine
reviews.text: I think this Airline can be a good option to be in your flight list, every thing is simple, fast and clean. just the pilots usually land with a very high speed which makes a big sound in the cabin
reviews.author: shiraziwine

reviews.title: Comfortable and not expensive
reviews.text: Beautiful lowcoster, wonderful pilots, friendly stewardesses and stewards, comfortable airplane - Embraer 190. On board sandwiches and water are offered for free, everything else can be bought additionally in the catalog. I recommend Buta Airways.
reviews.author: Olesya

reviews.title: Simple and Good
reviews.text: The flight was on time and soft, crew were polite and the aircraft was quite good, comfortable and clean. the Captain landed with high speed and i was not sure if he/she can control the aircraft Offered a big sandwich, not Vegan option but vegetarian option.
reviews.author: shiraziwine

reviews.title: Terrible airline
reviews.text: This is the only airline which charged us $15 each for the registration. It was not mention anywhere that the the registration will cost us. Later in Baku the tour operator told us that the Buta is controlled by the daughter of the president - and the money goes into her pocket.
reviews.author: Yasha A

reviews.title: Not bad and not very good ,
reviews.text: The planes are ok , the service lousy , the stewards and stewardesses shabby ,impolite .The flight was on time and a assume the pilots are well trained.Smooth take off and landing . The quality of the sandwich and the hot food they offered were minimal.
reviews.author: Abbas F

reviews.title: Terrible low-cost airline
reviews.text: Just a terrible, terrible airline. I'm more than accustomed to flying with low-cost airlines but this is easily the worst I've flown. Tickets do not include hand baggage at all as others have mentioned. My travel partner had a tiny over the shoulder bag the size a novel and they gave her a hard time with even that. After "escalating" it to a manager they finally let it go. They charge $15 USD per person for airport checkin. This would be totally fine if they actually mentioned this anywhere. The other ultra-low-cost airlines that charge for airport checkin make it explicitly clear during the booking process, but Buta doesn't make this clear at all. We were two passengers on the same booking and even after paying for the airport checkin (per person), they did not give us seats together. When we asked for seats together, we were told it would be another $20. Seriously even Ryanair doesn't do this - absolutely ridiculous. To top it all off, the flights were not particularly cheap. Overalll a horrible experience.
reviews.author: sunny182

reviews.title: Short flight and reasonably priced
reviews.text: A reasonably priced flight and only a short distance. Checking in at Tbilisi was quite disorganised, very crowded and no real lines. After a while we realised that most of the people lined up were not travelling just here to see family and friends off, they certainly were here in large numbers, babies in strollers etc. Would have helped significantly if they had waited to the side and not lined up. On board we were disappointed that whilst it was announced that seats were to be upright on takeoff, the guy in front had his fully reclined and persisted in jumping around. After a number of staff walked past we subtly indicated what was happening, they asked him to put his seat up, but as soon as the steward walked on he reclined again for takeoff and the whole trip, with stewards walking past. Other than this it was a good flight for this short distance.
reviews.author: NswAustraliaDidi

reviews.title: Azerbaijan Airways subsidiary for "short hops"!
reviews.text: Check-in is at Terminal 2 in Baku & the plane is a bit old. You get a snack on the flight but can pay for other food/drinks. I didn't use the toilet as I thought I'd be too big! The flights are at a convenient time & the plane was packed!!
reviews.author: Beddington210

reviews.title: Enough good!
reviews.text: The service is enough good for a low-cost airline. The only minus is that they operate some of their flights from the old terminal at Baku.

reviews.title: Ontime flight
reviews.text: Good take off and landing but awful meal.why they didn't host better?i wanted for a pillow ( because my late flight) and they refused to that

reviews.title: Low cost airline with a degree of professionalism
reviews.text: Buta aiways flies twice daily between Tbilisi and Baku. The leg room is slightly above average and the service is very good for a low cost airline. The only downside is that they operate some of their flights from the old terminal at Baku, which is terrible. They offer a complimentary sandwich as part of their on board service. Their customer service is available on Whatsapp which is absolutely incredible.

reviews.text: We checked in at IKIA Tehran. We were charged more than 100 USD for the luggage we carried which was more than the cost of the air ticket itself. The service was good though.

reviews.title: Good

So I had to put my back-pack into my carry-on (totally 7.59kg) to take them into the cabin with me. During the flight, you need to pay for the drinks and food.

reviews.title: Good , small price, no delayed, adequate service
reviews.text: Good, without delayed, adequate price and service. Comfortable and wide step between chairs. Sandwich and water :-) is included.

reviews.title: A surprise
reviews.text: Taking this low budget airlines and not expecting anything this was a pleasant surprise. Remarcable spacy seats,free sandwich and water. You found buy other things of course. It are older aircraft but for a short flight of +/- 1h they give good service.
reviews.author: stefaan37

reviews.title: nothing special
reviews.text: very empty plane. i think if it was full it would be a different story. check in was easy online. i can't remember where i saw but it was stated not checkin in online you paid at counter. i paid nothing for carry on and i was worried about that but was prepared to pay as i remember at time of booking. price were comparable for direct flight versus a connecting flight. i think i paid a bit more for the direct. staff were neither friendly nor rude just emotionless. never had the snack. seats were comfy, plane was clean and baggage made it there in one piece. typical low cost airline you pay for everything which is fine by me
reviews.author: hunglow

reviews.title: More expensive than full service airline
reviews.text: Like most budget airlines they charge you for literally everything and it ends up costing more than a full service airline. Pay to check in, pay for baggage, i had to pay for carry luggage too, I jokingly asked the stewardess how much it costs for oxygen on the plane, she replied. Oxygen is free today. I had to perform some yoga moves to get into my seat at 6'foot tall, good luck to anyway taller than that. I wont fly with these guys again.
reviews.author: Elthamboy

reviews.title: Terrible, money grabbing airline
reviews.text: I had a terrible experience with Buta Airways. Firstly flight was delayed 3 hours for no reason. Then at check-in, I was fined for not checking in online, however there is no mention on the ticket or confirmation email anywhere that you need to do online check-in. I asked for a window seat and was given an Aisle, when I asked to move onboard (as the flight wasn't full), I was told it would cost €25! They also don't allow any hand luggage, apart from a handbag or laptop bag. Not even a plastic bag! Now my return flight is also delayed. All in all, a very poor experience.
reviews.author: Jason D

reviews.title: Excellent for a low-cost carrier
reviews.text: I booked the flight directly on their website and the price was good - even better than what online travel agencies offered, as they seemed to offer the fare of Azerbaijan Airlines. I accidentally booked the flight for a wrong date and noticed it right away after receiving the tickets. Buta had a 3 h cancellation policy and it worked well: I queued about 5 minutes to their call center and the tickets were refunded. I then booked new ones. Buta Airways is the only carrier for international flights in Baku's terminal 2 and our flight was the only flight from the international wing that evening, so it was almost deserted. The baggage drop opened 2.5 hours before departure, but the security and passport control only a bit under 2 hours before. Boarding started early from a jetbridge and we left the gate over 10 minutes before departure time. The flight went well in a new Embraer jet. Even though it was a low-cost flight, a sandwich and a small glass of water were provided for free. We arrived ahead of schedule. The luggage rules were strict and a bit strange. Not even hand baggage was allowed on the cheapest fare and it was cheaper to have 10 kg of checked baggage than hand baggage. However at the bag drop the agent wondered why I don't take my backpack as carry-on and most of the people had hand baggage with them.
reviews.author: kuu-kanko

reviews.title: modern and economical airline
reviews.text: modern fleet of Embriar jets, good leg room, leather seats. very modern airport at Baku, fast track immigration and customs. No wifi, food available for purchase. Boarding of the flight by bus. Crew could be more courteous. Very low fares. Need to check in online not at airport. strict luggage rules.
reviews.author: Riad A

reviews.title: Fantastic Low Cost Carrier
reviews.text: I flew Buta for the first time this morning on the short flight from Baku to Tbilisi. I always try to avoid budget airlines where there's a choice, but on this route there isn't, but it didn't matter on this occasion as Buta were fantastic. I'd booked to take a hold bag, but as it happened I needed to take two. I was a bit concerned about this, but it was very easy to pay for an extra bag at the bag drop counter for a very reasonable price, 47AZN (about £20- imagine what Ryanair would try to charge!!) Buta fly from Terminal 2 at GYD which is a small and a bit dated, but there is a small lounge which you can access with Priority Pass. Boarding started on time and was quick and painless. Leg room is very reasonable, and they provide a complimentary sandwich and water as well as a chargeable bar/snacks. I ordered a hot meal when I booked, and it was very good by airline standards. The crew were friendly and the Captain kept us informed in both Azeri and English, and we arrived in Tbilisi 15 minutes early. So, a really good flight- some budget airlines in Western Europe would do well from taking a leaf from Buta's book!

reviews.author: ABBA

reviews.title: 2018 Dec Trip - Buta Airways (Tehran-Azerbaijan)
reviews.text: First time taking Buta Airways with my Wheelchair Elderly and the service was not disappointing and departing on time on flight J2 9006 (1hr 25min flying time). Sandwich and drinks were given. The only inconvenience was the flight time i.e. 1.25am and reach Baku at 3.20am. Anyway it's one of those experiences for us.
reviews.author: haryatijamil

reviews.title: Terrible customer service at GYD airport, dull website and decent aircraft
reviews.text: Booked ticked well is advance as it was reasonably priced. Later I have discovered a typo error and called customer service who advised to sent message via WhatsAp(!) and they will correct. Despite getting the message that the typo error was corrected their online system still shown the error during online check in process. We're family of five with three kids. So-called automated seat allocation put only two seats together. I can clearly see the row next, in front and in the rear to the allocated seat are still available. Upon arriving to airport for baggage drop off we still have to go through the whole check in process again. CS officer at check in was extremely rude and unhelpful trying to force us to buy additional baggage by misinterpreting t&c of small baggage carriage. Check in manager eventually got involved resolving the issue. Upon security check we have been told to return back to check in desk as their forgot to put "hand luggage" tag to our bags. Buta Air, Azal and the airport owned by the same state-owned company and the security officer effectively acting as an employee of the Buta/Azal therefore so-called online check is almost non existent. On the positive side the aircraft was in clean, good condition and the cabin crew were polite and professional.
reviews.author: Romio13

reviews.title: Good Budget Airline
reviews.text: Buta Airlines offers the only direct flight between Baku and Tbilisi, about 1h flight time with an Embraer 190. The flight to Tbilisi leaves at 22.00 and the return flight is scheduled for 01.45 thus arriving in Baku at 03.00 in the morning, not my preferred time of arrival. I had booked a seat with extra leg room which according to the airline costs 15 Euro per sector but my travel agency charged me 50 Manat (about 26 Euro); this infomation I found out when I got my boarding pass. According to SeatGuru my seat 14 H was an aisle seat next to the emergency exit. When I boarded the plane 14 H was not at the emergency exit but the first row which due to the bulkhead in fact reduces the legroom, In total 52 Euro spent for an uncomfortable seat. Apart from this disappointment I only have praise for Buta Airlines: Check in and boarding was efficient; they offer water and a sandwich, other snacks and drinks must be paid in cash; the plane left about 15 minutes before the scheduled departure time on both trips; staff is very friendly and helpfull. One boardcase can be taken on board. Except for the surcharge for a seat with reduced legroom for which I blame SeatGuru, I was very satisfied and definitely would chose Buta Airlines again for this trip.
reviews.author: Helmut S
